own_words.title: Say it in your own words

first_taf.title: Chase overdue invoices
first_taf.line: Reminds customers of overdue invoices on a schedule and reports who hasn't paid; moves no money.
first_taf.say: Each weekday morning, find my overdue invoices in my accounting or billing app and send a polite reminder to each customer from my email, at most one a week per invoice and 20 a day. Never change an invoice or offer a discount. Tell me who is more than 30 days late.
